2. Ways to choose 5 officers from the 9 non‑past candidates: \(\binom{9}{5}\).

Thus, the number of favorable elections is:
\[
\binom{16}{5} - \binom{9}{5}
\]

Compute the values:
\[
\binom{16}{5}= \frac{16\cdot15\cdot14\cdot13\cdot12}{5\cdot4\cdot3\cdot2\cdot1}=4368
\]
\[
\binom{9}{5}= \binom{9}{4}= \frac{9\cdot8\cdot7\cdot6}{4\cdot3\cdot2\cdot1}=126
\]

Subtract:
\[
4368 - 126 = 4242
\]

So, 4 242 elections will have at least one of the past officers.
